WSSF.description: Wall Stiffness Scale Factor (WSSF). The url key is the wall element ID; ITEMS holds one entry per boundary group with the per-direction stiffness scale factors applied to that wall element.

ITEMS.description: List of wall stiffness scale factor entries for the wall element identified by the url key. Each item pairs a boundary group with its scale factors.

ID.description: Serial ID of the scale-factor entry within the wall element. If omitted, the key is resolved from GROUP_NAME.

GROUP_NAME.description: Name of the boundary group this scale factor applies to. Must reference an existing boundary group; an empty/omitted value uses the default (group key 0).

AXIAL.description: [WallType=1] Axial stiffness scale factor. Applies only to wall type 1 elements.

OUT_TORSION.description: [WallType=1] Out-of-plane torsion stiffness scale factor. Applies only to wall type 1 elements.

OUT_SHEAR.description: [WallType=1] Out-of-plane shear stiffness scale factor. Applies only to wall type 1 elements.

OUT_BENDING.description: [WallType=1] Out-of-plane bending stiffness scale factor. Applies only to wall type 1 elements.
